# Known non-conformances of the server against the third-party JMAP client run
# (internal/api/jmapclient_integration_test.go, CI job jmap-client).
#
# One line per step that is ALLOWED TO FAIL today:
#   step-id <TAB> reference <TAB> what is wrong
#
# `gap-NN` is a real non-conformance, waiting for its issue (replace NN with the
# issue number when it is filed). `limit-adr042` is a deliberate Mailroom limit
# (API keys cannot reach some methods and routes) recorded here because the
# server still advertises the thing a key cannot use.
#
# The job is red when a step fails and is NOT listed here (a regression), and
# also when a listed step starts passing (delete its line: the fix landed).
# Add a line only with a reference; a line without one is rejected.
session.urls-are-absolute	#100	session apiUrl/downloadUrl/uploadUrl/eventSourceUrl are relative; go-jmap hands them to net/http unresolved
session.readonly-key-account-is-readonly	#101	account.isReadOnly is false for a key with only read scopes
mailbox.query-by-role	#102	Mailbox/query ignores its filter (role=inbox returns every mailbox) instead of unsupportedFilter
email.query.anchor	#103	Email/query ignores anchor
email.query.negative-position	#104	Email/query position=-1 is echoed back as -1 (invalid) and the list is not offset from the end
email.get.malformed-id	#105	Email/get drops a malformed id: it is in neither list nor notFound
email.get.message-id-properties	#106	Email.messageId keeps the angle brackets; absent inReplyTo/references are [] not null
email.get.ids-null	#107	Email/get without ids answers invalidArguments; RFC 8620 5.1 allows null ids (or requestTooLarge)
blob.download-attachment	limit-adr042	API keys cannot reach /jmap/download (ADR-042 3), yet the session a key receives advertises downloadUrl
email.querychanges	limit-adr042	Email/queryChanges is not available to API keys, yet Email/query tells a key canCalculateChanges=true
error.not-json	#108	invalid JSON body is answered notRequest; RFC 8620 3.6.1 says notJSON
email.query.filter.inMailboxOtherThan	#109	Email/query inMailboxOtherThan is unsupportedFilter
email.query.filter.from-name	#110	from filter is search-engine matching (tokenised/fuzzy), not RFC substring: other senders at the same domain match
email.query.filter.from-ignores-to-header	#110	from filter is search-engine matching (tokenised/fuzzy), not RFC substring: other senders at the same domain match
email.query.filter.hasAttachment	#111	Email/query filter condition not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.filter.minSize	#111	Email/query filter condition not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.filter.maxSize	#111	Email/query filter condition not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.filter.header	#111	Email/query filter condition not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.filter.someInThreadHaveKeyword	#111	Email/query filter condition not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.filter.noneInThreadHaveKeyword	#111	Email/query filter condition not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.filter.allInThreadHaveKeyword	#111	Email/query filter condition not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.operator.AND	#112	Email/query FilterOperator (AND/OR/NOT) is not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.operator.OR	#112	Email/query FilterOperator (AND/OR/NOT) is not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.operator.NOT	#112	Email/query FilterOperator (AND/OR/NOT) is not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.operator.nested	#112	Email/query FilterOperator (AND/OR/NOT) is not implemented (unsupportedFilter)
email.query.sort.size	#113	Email/query sort property not implemented (invalidArguments); RFC 8621 4.4.2 requires it
email.query.sort.from	#113	Email/query sort property not implemented (invalidArguments); RFC 8621 4.4.2 requires it
email.query.sort.to	#113	Email/query sort property not implemented (invalidArguments); RFC 8621 4.4.2 requires it
email.query.sort.subject	#113	Email/query sort property not implemented (invalidArguments); RFC 8621 4.4.2 requires it
email.query.sort.hasKeyword	#113	Email/query sort property not implemented (invalidArguments); RFC 8621 4.4.2 requires it
email.get.property.header:List-Id:asText	#114	Email/get silently drops header:* and headers properties instead of returning them or refusing them
email.get.property.header:Message-ID:asMessageIds	#114	Email/get silently drops header:* and headers properties instead of returning them or refusing them
email.get.property.header:From:asAddresses	#114	Email/get silently drops header:* and headers properties instead of returning them or refusing them
email.get.property.header:To:asAddresses:all	#114	Email/get silently drops header:* and headers properties instead of returning them or refusing them
email.get.property.header:Date:asDate	#114	Email/get silently drops header:* and headers properties instead of returning them or refusing them
email.get.property.header:Subject	#114	Email/get silently drops header:* and headers properties instead of returning them or refusing them
email.get.property.header:X-Absent:asText	#114	Email/get silently drops header:* and headers properties instead of returning them or refusing them
email.get.property.headers	#114	Email/get silently drops header:* and headers properties instead of returning them or refusing them
mailbox.changes.after-move	#115	Mailbox state and Mailbox/changes do not move when a message move changes mailbox counts
